ios.notes:
Tap a playlist, folder, mix or artist and the page opens out of the cover you tapped.
Every round play button is now the metal one, and the QR code moved into Send to friends.

Duotone for iPhone 6.2.0

New
- Opening a playlist, folder, mix or artist grows the page out of the cover you tapped, and the cover lands at the top of the page. Back shrinks it into the same spot.
- QR code in Send to friends: tap the QR next to the playlist, and a friend's iPhone camera opens it in Duotone. It's drawn on your iPhone.
- Lists on Home (mixes and See all) now have Play and Shuffle.

Improved
- Every round play button is the metal one: the song of the moment, artist pages, playlists, the Daily mix and songs in chats. It follows Customise → Play button.
- "Playing from" at the top of the player now says where the song came from: profiles, Home shelves, search, a friend's song, Downloads, stats, Year in review, You two, albums and "Play now" in menus. In a Jam it says Jam and opens it.
- Songs on profiles and in chats open the same menu as everywhere else, and holding a song opens it. "Remove from profile" is there for your song of the moment.

Fixed
- Swiping a message to reply no longer loses to the chat scrolling.

Minimum version: 6.0.1

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v6.1.2...ios-v6.2.0

windows.notes:
Clicking a lyric line with the 3D cover jumps there again, and switches, menus and shelves feel more at home on Windows.

Duotone for Windows 7.0.6

Improved
- The Albums folder opens up on hover, and the tiles of a playlist mosaic lift apart.
- One metal switch everywhere: the Jam, Settings and the EQ presets. Changing section in Settings slides the new card in.
- Shelf arrows and dragging stop at the start of a card, and so do the trackpad and the wheel.
- Recommendations and Edit profile open in the PC's own dialog.
- The song of the moment on a profile has the metal play button, and its menu has "Remove from profile" on your own profile.
- "Play now" from a profile or a chat menu shows where the song is playing from.

Fixed
- With the 3D cover turned to the lyrics, clicking a line jumps there instead of doing nothing most of the time.
- Closing a menu opened with the mouse no longer leaves a keyboard outline on the card.
- The Spotify import choices respond to the mouse.

Minimum version: 7.0.0

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/win-v7.0.5...win-v7.0.6

windowsPreview.notes:
Duotone Preview 0.2.0

New
- Social redesigned: conversations without a frame, the friend you're listening with in a resizable panel on the right, the window takes their cover's colour, and messages, rows and panels animate in and out.
- The Preview now updates itself (installed copy only).

Improved
- Panels, dialogs, notices, menus and the selection bar slide in and out instead of popping.

Fixed
- Settings restored from your account after launch (3D cover, two-tone covers, layout, colour) now apply right away.
- The Preview no longer asks you to install the Duotone update.
- Friend lists could jump far off screen while reordering.
